name: Anthropic
summary: Anthropic develops the Claude family of large language models and related consumer, developer, and enterprise products.

product.one_liner: Claude models and products for chat, API access, and enterprise workflows
product.description: Anthropic trains and serves Claude language models. Public product surfaces include Claude consumer/team chat products, a developer API, and enterprise offerings. Documented capabilities include general reasoning, coding assistance, tool use, and long-context workflows.
key_capabilities: chat products for individuals and teams

market.primary_persona: Developers, knowledge workers, and enterprise AI buyers
market.problem: Buyers need general-purpose language model systems they can access via products and APIs for assistants, coding, and internal workflows

business_model.notes: Public surfaces include API usage pricing and subscription plans for Claude products; enterprise packaging is also described on company pages. Exact contract structures are not fully public.

ai_profile.model_strategy: Trains and serves proprietary Claude models as the primary product substrate
ai_profile.data_advantage: Public materials emphasize alignment/safety methods and product feedback loops; proprietary training data details are not fully disclosed
ai_profile.notes: AI capability is the product: model training, serving, and assistant/API surfaces. Removing the models removes the company offering.

signals.label: product_surface
signals.value: Public Claude chat, API docs, research publications index, and enterprise product pages are live

signals.label: distribution_channels
signals.value: Direct web products plus developer API distribution

signals.label: developer_activity
signals.value: Public API docs and developer-facing model documentation are available; research index publishes ongoing technical work

signals.label: monetization_signals
signals.value: Public API pricing and Claude subscription plans are listed

traction.notes: No audited user, revenue, or usage metrics are included. community_signals and hiring_signals are omitted until sourced. Soft popularity claims are omitted.

funding.notes: Public press cites large funding rounds with conflicting totals. Numeric fields remain null until a single dated primary or high-quality secondary source is attached.

product.rationale: Judgment: clear model + API + assistant product surfaces with coherent buyer paths; sharp packaging for a foundation-model lab.

market.rationale: Judgment: foundation models are a clear, active category with identifiable lab peers. Capped at 4: no category-level demand source beyond company materials (homepage alone cannot justify 5).

business_model.rationale: Judgment: usage and subscription monetization are publicly visible; enterprise economics are only partially observable.

technology.rationale: Judgment (model layer): owns and serves frontier models rather than wrapping third-party APIs — rare depth within the foundation-model peer frame; public research program supports technical depth claims.

growth.rationale: Not scored: no sourced public growth metrics in this entry.

competitive_position.rationale: Judgment (model layer): established frontier peer-set member with strong public brand; durable relative share versus OpenAI/Google/etc. is not measured here.
